families.decision: Organic fruit from a named small farm, with ripeness matched to the eating day.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic; prefer the added Real Organic seal.
Read the farm sign for a small grower, growing location and seasonal harvest.
Check 'ripe and ready' or 'ripen at home' wording against the fruit's firmness.
Read the organic label; a voluntary PLU alone is not reliable certification.

families.decision: Whole organic fruit from a named small farm, selected at eating ripeness.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic; prefer the added Real Organic seal.
Read the farm sign for a small grower, growing location and seasonal harvest.
Pick whole fruit at eating ripeness; skip mold, split skins and wet decay.
Read the organic label; a voluntary PLU alone is not reliable certification.

families.decision: Whole organic vegetables from a named small farm, with firm heads, pods or peppers.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic; prefer the added Real Organic seal.
Read the farm sign for a small grower, growing location and seasonal harvest.
Check heads, pods and peppers for firmness, split skins and visible decay.
Read the organic label; a voluntary PLU alone is not reliable certification.

produce_apples_pears.decision: Organic apples and pears from a named small orchard, with apples labeled unwaxed.
produce_apples_pears.delta: Apples labeled unwaxed; European pears yield slightly near the stem.

produce_citrus.decision: Organic citrus labeled unwaxed, from a named small grove.
produce_citrus.delta: For zest, read 'unwaxed' or 'uncoated' on the citrus label.

produce_stone_fruit.decision: Real Organic peaches, nectarines, plums and cherries from a named small orchard.
produce_stone_fruit.delta: Peaches, nectarines and plums give gently when ripe; cherries stay firm with stems attached.

produce_bananas.decision: Organic bananas labeled as grown by small farmers, yellow for eating now.
produce_bananas.delta: Full yellow for eating now; brown speckles mark the fully ripe stage.

produce_avocados.decision: Organic avocados from a named small farm, yielding gently for eating now.
produce_avocados.delta: Judge readiness with gentle palm pressure, not fingertips; skip overly soft fruit.

produce_grapes.decision: Real Organic grapes from a named small vineyard, plump and firmly attached.
produce_grapes.delta: Plump grapes firmly attached to stems; Northern California harvest Jul-Nov.

produce_melons.decision: Whole organic melons from a named small local farm, with intact rinds.
produce_melons.delta: Watermelon with a creamy-yellow ground spot; cantaloupe with tan-yellow skin between the netting.

produce_tropical_fruit.decision: Whole organic tropical fruit with the small grower and origin named.
produce_tropical_fruit.delta: Mangoes give slightly when ripe; buy pineapple already ripe, as it will not ripen after harvest.

berries_picking.decision: Real Organic berries from a named small local farm, in dry, shallow packs.
berries_picking.delta: Shallow packs with dry berries to the base; skip crushed berries beneath the top layer.

produce_ripeness_by_item.decision: Organic fruit with its variety and farm named, at that variety's eating ripeness.
produce_ripeness_by_item.delta: Match peel color to the named variety; Sugarloaf pineapples stay green when ripe.

produce_seasonality.decision: Organic fruit from a named small local farm during its regional harvest.
produce_seasonality.delta: Northern California tomatoes Jun-Oct, bell peppers Jul-Nov.

produce_tomatoes.decision: Real Organic tomatoes from a named small local farm, with a slight give.
produce_tomatoes.delta: Slight give for eating today; Northern California tomatoes Jun-Oct.

produce_peppers.decision: Real Organic bell peppers from a named small local farm, firm and smooth.
produce_peppers.delta: Colored bell peppers have ripened beyond green; Northern California bells Jul-Nov.

groups.title: Apples, pears and stone fruit
groups.why_same: Both use the orchard's organic label, named small grower and whole-fruit inspection, with ripeness checked for the named fruit.
